boundary.resolution: The introduction and visible-image sequence distinguish register geometry, optional GTE color calculations, explicit cartridge GP0 submission, GPU graphics-memory writes and PCRTC display sampling. The example contains the concrete adjacent-unit setup rather than a promised future chapter.

registers.resolution: Register reference inventories all 76 words with byte addresses, fields, access/reset rules, signed-halfword transformations, aliases, FIFO pushes, derived RGB/leading-sign reads, ignored writes and both flag formats. Bit maps use real tables.

datapath.resolution: Operation-specific scale/packing guidance and per-command purpose/input/option/output entries cover all22 normal functions plus VMAD3. The retained exact arithmetic specifies44-bit ordered wrap, clamps, matrix/cv2 behavior, reciprocal algorithm and257 ROM bytes. H is an unscaled projection numerator, not a shared scene-coordinate scale; NCLIP is doubled oriented area with MAC0 overflow qualifications.

visibility.resolution: Result visibility distinguishes immediate normal-command results from pending PLUS operands/results, old output visibility, deadline publication, direct word-store interlock and separate normal/PLUS state. Register-access cautions cover F64 second-word admission and word-sequence readiness preflight.

timing.resolution: Mirrored installed-model and live timing/CPU owners establish33,868,800 system cycles/s, two-cycle admitted scalar word-store base cost, normal nominal counts without extra GTE CPU charge, and PLUS five/one-cycle deadlines. Specification tables distinguish logical32-bit transfers and arithmetic admission ceiling from physical bus guarantees.
open: Independent GTE core clock and physical GTE/IO bus clock, pin width, arbitration/contended-transfer schedule and sustained guaranteed bandwidth are not defined by the inspected model/owners. These require an explicit hardware-specification decision; the draft states that they are not specified and does not invent Sony values.

interrupts.resolution: Interrupts states the sourced absence of GTE completion IRQs and IRQ control words. PLUS result polling and the direct command word-store interlock are distinct mechanisms, not IRQ delivery.

faults.resolution: Register accesses and bus faults distinguishes CPU alignment rejection from mapped IO width/offset faults, ordinary modes, float-transfer encodings and successive accesses, ignored nonfaulting register writes, PLUS DMA denial, arithmetic flags and invalid-command outcomes. No DMA channel or whole-ISA policy is inferred.

reset.resolution: Reset clears all register words, accumulators, cycle state and pending PLUS work and releases a blocked command store. There is no guest GTE reset word. Save-state mechanics remain editorial facts only.

programming.resolution: Parallel-written programming sections teach matrix packing/scales/SF/LM, retained state, flags, and actual choices per command. Ordered triangle RTPT->NCLIP->AVSZ3 feeds an explicit GP0 clear/draw and PCRTC latch sequence with visible pixel results; translated RTPS, NCCS, DPCS and PLUS examples have independently checked numerical readbacks. The triangle+scanout recipe ran through mapped TS owners and software raster/scanout, not a guest cartridge or native run.
